subtitle_html: For 17 October 2026 · project moxir-v2-10 (rig v2.10) · written 2026-10-15 by the scenes designer, re-coloured 03:15 (v2) and 06:0x (v3, Palette 3) after the owner's verdicts · data: moxir-scenes-50-2026-10-15.json

1.name: Arrive in the dark
1.colour: ice, steel blue and petrol (t8 hangar, t5 haze); warm white only on the DJ; the floor ice

2.name: Build
2.colour: the poster's green made soft: poster green and glow on the beams, mint and petrol on the washes; the floor mint

3.name: First peak
3.colour: cold white hits, lavender and petrol, rose-copper warmth; red only in the red room; the floor rose-copper

4.name: Breakdown
4.colour: petrol and deep sea (blue-green reads brightest in the dark), ice, lavender; one green laser breath; the floor petrol

5.name: Second peak, then out
5.colour: white-out, an ice strobe, lavender; fire only as accents (the ember plane, the red laser fans, the last embers); warm white, then ice and the cold beam of act 1; the floor lavender, then ice
